_readme: Hand-maintained list of player_ids who have retired, mapped to their last active season. ESPN never marks a retired player inactive in the kona player pool (they linger as free agents with active:true), so without this cap a retired player's seasons_seen and latest-season player_seasons row keep extending into the year they retired. Read by scripts/normalize.py to trim players.json seasons_seen and drop player_seasons.json rows above the cap. This is the player-side mirror of retired-owners.json -- retirement isn't an ESPN API fact, it's a real-world event the commissioner reports. Remove an entry if the player returns to MLB.
